300882765 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENTisenteredintoasof January 25, 2006 between 18 East 23"d Street Realty Company, LLC ("Owner” or “Seller"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at 18 East 23"d Street, New York, NY 10010 and 23rd Street, LLC, ("Purchaser” or “Developer"), a New York limited liability company,having an office at 1065 Avenue of the Americas, 27th Floor, New York,New York 10018. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Seller is the owner in fee of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon,located in the Borough of Manhattan,City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 60 in Block 851 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known as 18 East 23rd Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit "A"” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Owner's Property” and said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the “Owner's Building"); WHEREAS,Purchaser is the owner in fee of certain land,with the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 59 in Block 851 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known as 20 East 23?d Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit "B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Developer's permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the “Developer's Building"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the existing improvements on Developer's Property and to construct thereon a new building (such new building, as the same may be altered, modified, improved or replaced from time to time, the “New Building"); and WHEREAS, the parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, (herein called the "Declaration"), a copy of which Declaration is annexed hereto as Exhibit C and made a part hereof, which seeks to effectuate the intentions of the parties set forth in the preamble to this Agreement by creating a Developer's Property. WHEREAS,it is planned that theNewBuilding will contain more Floor Area(as hereinafter defined) than is now permitted to be constructed on the Developer's Property pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as defined herein) with the result that developer desires to make use of the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Property and the Owner's Property into a single “zoning lot”" for the purpose of making available the Available Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) in connection with the construction of the New Building; and NY2:1480062101\VQ0%01!.DOC\18485.0003

WHEREAS,Owner desires to allow Developer to utilize the Available Development Rights in the New Building and, in connection therewith, to grant to Developer certain rights and easements with respect to Owner's Property as more specifically set forth herein; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Single Zoning Lot. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises contained herein and other good and valuable consideration the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereby agree as follows: Section 1.Definitions (a)“Available Development Rights”shall mean those Floor Area Development Rights in excess of those Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Owner's Building on the date hereof. (b) “Floor Area Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a “zoning lot”", to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total “floor area" determined (i) by multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, and (i) by the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use,bulk,density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York from time to time; (c)“Retained Development Rights”shall mean those Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the Owner's Building on the date hereof.It is agreed and acknowledged that as of the date hereof the Retained Development Rights comprise the total allowable Floor Area Development Rights less the Available Development Rights. (d) “"Violations" shall mean a violation of the Zoning Resolution or any law, ordinance, order, requirement, rule or regulation issued by any municipal department or other governmental authority. (e)“"Waiver” shall mean any waiver(s) of declaration of zoning lot restrictions and Lot, executed and delivered at or any time after the date hereof. (f) “Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective as of December 15,1961, as amended from time to time. Undefined terms used in this Agreement which are defined in the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, “Floor area", "floor area ratio", “zoning lot”", “parties in interest", Section12-10oftheZoningResolution.
